story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 business dates used by the transaction effective date logic
gaps: TC_004 and TC_006 share the same business intent: "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 identifies Maintenance Date and refreshes the Facets transaction effective date from the Maintenance Date" and "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 uses the first Maintenance Date when multiple Maintenance Date values are present in one inbound file" both validate Maintenance Date driving the winning transaction effective date and Facets Eligibility Date update; TC_006 already covers the maintenance-date flow.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
gaps: Semantic duplicate: TC_002 and TC_003 validate the same business intent: Eligibility Date wins before eligibility begins when Assessment Date is earlier. Evidence from Test Case Name/Description: TC_002 'Verify AR PASSE new enrollment uses Eligibility Date from DTP*348 as the transaction effective date before eligibility begins' with Description 'Validate an AR PASSE new-enrollment inbound 834 uses the future Eligibility Date carried in Loop 2000 DTP*348 as the transaction effective date when the member eligibility span has not yet begun'; TC_003 'Verify AR PASSE new enrollment keeps the future Eligibility Date as the winning transaction effective date when Assessment Date is earlier' with Description 'Validate an AR PASSE new-enrollment inbound 834 keeps the future Eligibility Date as the winning transaction effective date when the member eligibility span has not yet begun and the Assessment Date in Loop 2300 HD03 is earlier'

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date as the transaction effective date when current eligibility has an Assessment Date change

flagged.why: wrong field expectation for date extension

gaps: Expected Result contains "The Facets field labeled 834 Spans Date Extension reflects the changed relevant field for the processed span and is not blank after the change transaction." in Expected Result, but the scenario is "Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Loop 2300 HD03 as the transaction effective date."; add a dedicated test case for the missing clause "2) Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date and unchanged relevant fields preserves the existing relevant field values while using Assessment Date."

Expected Result contains "The Facets field labeled 834 Spans Date Extension reflects the changed relevant field for the processed span and is not blank after the change transaction." in Expected Result, which contradicts hint "FACETS UI FIELDS this story's rule writes, verified in the UI by these literal labels: 'Eligibility Date' refreshes to the winning date, and '834 Spans Date Extension' reflects the changed relevant field." for this changed-Assessment-Date case with no stated changed relevant field.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility changes when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant fields change
gaps: Step Description contains "using the ARPasse naming pattern TP028433_E/U/T/CYYYYJJJ_(9DigitSequence).834" in TC_004 step 1; this contradicts hint "FILE NAMING: the 'E' prefix is for new-enrollment files only; update/change files use the 'U' prefix with a control number specific to that test case."

Pre-condition contains "and Facets CRT with the product file C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files\OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb." in TC_010; this contradicts hint "ENVIRONMENT CONSTANTS: TM UI = https://edifecstmenr-crt.caresource.corp:8443/tm/logon/logon.jsp; staging = \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound; archive = \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\AR; trading partner = AR PASSE." and the Arkansas context stated throughout the scenario/test case text.

Step Description contains "In Facets, open the database file C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files\OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb" in TC_010 step 24; this conflicts with the Arkansas scenario context in the same test case text: "Arkansas AR PASSE test data exists for one member".

Pre-condition contains "and Facets CRT with the product file C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files\OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb." in TC_011; this conflicts with the Arkansas context stated in the same test case text: "Arkansas AR PASSE test data exists for one member".

Step Description contains "Launch Facets Certification through Citrix Workspace, open C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files\OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb" in TC_011 step 11; this conflicts with the Arkansas scenario context in the same test case text: "Arkansas AR PASSE test data exists for one member".

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility changes when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant fields change
Verify combinations of eligibility timing, Assessment Date change status, and relevant-field change status
gaps: Semantic duplicate: 'TC_002' and 'TC_003' validate the same business intent that a current-eligibility update with a changed Assessment Date results in the transaction effective date using the Assessment Date. Evidence in Test Case Name/Description: TC_002 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility with Assessment Date changed and relevant fields unchanged populates the transaction effective date from the Assessment Date' / 'where the Assessment Date changes and the relevant fields remain unchanged, loads the winning transaction effective date from the Assessment Date'; TC_003 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility with Assessment Date changed and relevant fields changed still populates the transaction effective date from the Assessment Date' / 'where the Assessment Date changes and relevant fields also change, still loads the winning transaction effective date from the Assessment Date'

scenarios.title: Restrict Maintenance Date usage to the rule path explicitly allowed by the story
Verify capitation and finance reporting regression after transaction effective date selection changes
